review.scope: Approximate shared system motion for confirmed members only. retainedDonorRecord.name: Capella Aa
retainedDonorRecord.notes: Corrected CNS5 1318; exact source identity * alf Aur. Former combined giant-pair source snapshot, shared as an approximate Aa/Ab position and proper motion. No resolved orbital trajectory is claimed. Resolve the giant pair using component values from Torres et al. 2015; retain the existing stable ID for the cooler primary. The known wide H/L pair makes this a quadruple. The paper system age range 0.590-0.650 Gyr is retained in provenance and not converted into an invented point estimate. Reviewed membership and individual physical parameters: arXiv:1505.07461. Individually reviewed physical values/withholding: arXiv:1505.07461; supersedes blended-source values for these fields. Reviewed component supplement: Component-specific published measurements supersede earlier withholding of aggregate measurements. No parent flux or unreviewed individual velocity is copied. The spectroscopic orbital gamma describes the Aa/Ab center of mass; no instantaneous giant orbital RV is modeled. Adopted fields: age_gyr: 2015ApJ...807...26T:7 (model-derived); radial_velocity_kms: 2015ApJ...807...26T:Table 2 (systemic-approximation). Component-scoped catalog measurements/estimates; details in catalog-work/star-systems/catalog-companions-audit.json.

reviewedLiterature.note: Achernar: individual component constraints from Kervella et al. (2022). A mass subtracts the model-based B mass from the dynamical total; B mass is evolutionary-model based. A remains a fast rotator, so the scalar diameter/temperature are averages.

review.scope: Approximate shared system motion for confirmed members only. Published gamma where identified; otherwise the existing compiled parent/member RV is a proxy that may contain orbital, pulsation, wind, or gravitational shifts. Measurement uncertainty does not bound those effects. Existing individual RVs and existing velocity vectors are preserved; no orbital phase is modeled.

retainedOriginal.notes: Detected ORB6 visual pair 01377-5714 KRV  54, component A. Unresolved parent photometry, physical parameters and space motion withheld. Shared parent position/distance is approximate unless individual astrometry is available. ORB6 magnitudes are withheld because their photometric band is not guaranteed to be Johnson V. Component-scoped catalog measurements/estimates; details in catalog-work/star-systems/catalog-companions-audit.json. Reviewed individual literature: Achernar: individual component constraints from Kervella et al. (2022). A mass subtracts the model-based B mass from the dynamical total; B mass is evolutionary-model based. Radii/temperatures/luminosities use component SEDs and mean limb-darkened diameters. A age is a rotating evolutionary-track estimate; no B age copied from A. A remains a fast rotator, so the scalar diameter/temperature are averages.

brightSystemMotion.vectorScope: Donor astrometry with shared RV; existing non-null velocity vector retained independently. Native component proper motion need not reproduce the separately adopted bulk vector.

retainedDonorRecord.notes: 10pc census (2023-08-25), object 31, system 16; alf CMi A. J2000 Sun-relative Galactic position via Astropy; full-space-motion.   No orbital model. Procyon A component parameters: dynamical mass and preferred 2.70 Gyr high-core-overshoot age from Bond et al. (2015); age is model-dependent (alternative tracks 1.673 and 1.817 Gyr). Chiavassa et al. (2012) provide 6591 +/- 43 K and the 2.019 solar interferometric radius; the alternative bolometric flux gives 6556 +/- 84 K. Photospheric [Fe/H] is the differential 3D LTE result of Allende Prieto et al. (2002). Component-resolved Johnson V=0.34 from 1953ApJ...117..313J; 2015ApJ...813..106B; absolute V uses the adopted distance. luminosity_solar derived by Stefan-Boltzmann scaling from adopted inputs (solar Teff=5772 K); inherits their measurement/model/estimate assumptions. Preserve the existing reviewed component-scoped physical parameters and their published/derived provenance. Primary-only Procyon A classification; the composite F5IV-V+DQZ spectrum is not appropriate for a component A row.

retainedDonorRecord.name: Sirius A
retainedDonorRecord.notes: Sirius system position and physical properties use Bond et al. (2017), including the adopted 378.9 mas parallax. The component offset is below this catalog's spatial precision. Motion: system motion shared by A and B; Hipparcos proper motion (SIMBAD HIP 32349; 2007A&A...474..653V) and true systemic RV -8.47 km/s from Bond et al. (2017) section V.1. No binary orbital motion; Galactic conversion documented in README. Sirius A reviewed physical parameters from Bond et al. (2017). The radius is interferometric, the mass dynamical, and the luminosity and temperature use the adopted parallax. The age and bulk [Fe/H] are stellar-evolution model results; the bulk metallicity is used instead of Sirius A's diffusion-altered Am photospheric abundance. Full classification of Sirius A, including metallic-line morphology; Sirius B is separate.

record.name: Sirius B
record.notes: Sirius system position and white-dwarf properties use Bond et al. (2017). The component offset is below this catalog's spatial precision. Motion: inherited Sirius system motion as for A; Hipparcos proper motion (2007A&A...474..653V) and true systemic RV -8.47 km/s from Bond et al. (2017) section V.1.
